name: Gregor
source:
A football aficionado, he loves his friends and is a very straightforward person who knows exactly what he wants. Gregor easily became a friend of Liam as soon as they met, enjoying his company and his mind for helping with those hard homework assignments. Even if Liam says otherwise, Gregor does everything possible to keep his friends close.
